notes.title: Cozy Holes 1.0.1 🌊 Bug Fixes and Review Request!
notes.notes:
UPDATES:


🌊 New Water Action

You can now spray water using Right Shoulder / Bumper on gamepad or Right Mouse Click.

Fully set up and tested — get rid of that lava! 💧

🔥 Lava Fix

Fixed a sneaky bug where players could die from lava without visibly touching it.

Now only actual contact with lava will send you back topside.

📜 Story Tablet Reset

Fixed an issue where stone tablets wouldn’t reset when starting a new game.

New adventures now start with a fresh slate!





Thank you to everyone sharing feedback since launch — keep it coming!

Please MAKE SURE TO DROP A REVIEW! We are just a 2-person team working on this game out of passion. Reviews go a long way towards helping us make sure we can continue to add even more content!

notes.title: Demo Update v7: Leaderboards, Replayability & RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Demo Update v7: Leaderboards, Replayability & Subtle Secrets

We’ve been busy preparing for our upcoming early access release, but wanted to bring you another cozy chunk of updates! This patch includes a much-requested New Game mode, a shiny new Leaderboard system, and a few quiet additions… if you know where to dig. Before we dig into the details, we are thrilled to announce Cozy Holes will be releasing in Early Access on August 6th, 2025!

🏁 Start Over, Your Way  
– You can now fully restart your adventure with a new “New Game” confirmation option  
– Clear your progress and replay the demo from day one  
– No more waiting for the in-game clock to run out!

🏆 Leaderboards Are Live  
– We’ve launched our first public leaderboard system!  
– Compete for the deepest dig and see how you stack up  
– Whoever holds the top spot on August 6th, 2025 (our early access launch day) will win a free copy of the game!  
– Bonus: Top scores and more details are viewable on our website

🪐 Something Strange Overhead…  
– Some players have reported seeing unusual events in the sky…  
– That’s probably nothing. Keep digging.

🛠️ Polish, Fixes & New Landmarks  
– Visual upgrades and material polish across several areas  
– Lighting tweaks and improved object interaction  
– Continued work on new landmarks — not all are accessible in the demo, but they’re waiting for you later

---

Thanks again to everyone who’s played and shared feedback. Your support means everything to our tiny team as we prepare for Cozy Holes' early access release on August 6th! If you haven’t yet, please consider wishlisting the game — it really helps ❤️

🦴 Follow @CozyHoles on X (Twitter)  
📧 contact@flashpointgames.com

notes.title: Demo Update v6: New Settings, Better Performance, and Treasure Merging
notes.notes:
New Settings, Better Performance, and Treasure Merging

We’re back with another update! This one adds a full visual settings menu based on player feedback, improves controller support, and introduces some fun new ways to collect and combine your treasures. It’s all about player comfort, clarity, and cozy hoarding.

🐾 Dogby Gets Smarter  
– Improved navigation and polish for Dogby the dog companion  
– Unlocking Dogby now triggers a Steam achievement  
– You’ll now see a subtle hint when Dogby becomes available, making it easier to find him  

💎 Collect, Combine, and Stack  
Valuables just got a glow-up — and now physics is part of the fun.  
– Collect items from inside the hut (finally!)  
– Push matching valuables together in the world to merge them into larger, more valuable versions  
– New sparkle FX make successful merges extra satisfying ✨

🎛️ New Settings Menu  
We’ve added a full settings panel to make Cozy Holes more accessible to more players:  
– Camera shake toggle (on/off — useful for those with motion sensitivity)  
– Fullscreen / windowed support  
– Resolution selection with save between sessions  
– Quality level options (low, medium, high, very high)  
– Music & SFX volume sliders  

🎮 Controller & Input Polish  
– Added D-pad support for navigating the UI  
– Improved controller dead zones for better precision  
– Smoother camera behavior while digging and exploring  

🎵 New Music Tracks  
– Added new music tracks to expand the atmosphere and emotional range of the island  

🧠 UI & Interaction Improvements  
– New bottom-of-screen UI messages for clarity on main/settings menus
– Fixed some stuck HUD messages after pausing or returning from menus  

🐛 Small Fixes & Extras  
– Tornadoes now avoid lava and ocean when spawning  & navigating
– Other minor bug fixes
---

Thanks again for playing and sharing your feedback. If you haven’t already, wishlist Cozy Holes to support the project and stay updated!

🦴 Follow @CozyHoles on X (Twitter)  
📧 contact@flashpointgames.com  
💬 Or jump into the Steam discussions

notes.title: Demo Update v5: Climbing Our Way Out
notes.notes:
Demo Update v5: Climb Easier, Run Smoother

We heard you loud and clear and are happy to announce a new update addressing your feedback! This update focuses on accessibility and performance — helping more players explore the island with less friction (and fewer stuck moments).

🧭 Easier Movement
– Refined movement lets you walk up walls when facing them  
– Players can now escape tricky holes without jumping  
– Falling and slope behavior tuned for smoother flow

⚙️ Performance Upgrades
– Optimized terrain and asteroid LODs  
– Improved low-end quality settings  
– Reworked water/rain colliders to prevent unwanted hits

🐛 Bug Fixes & Polish
– Lava now triggers a fade-to-black transition  
– Tornadoes better navigate around terrain  
– New MUSIC!
– Cleaner UI transitions, music triggers, and more


---

Thanks again for playing the demo — we’re continuing to fine-tune based on your feedback!

Follow us on X (Twitter)  
📧 contact@flashpointgames.com
